cleaner.label: Workstation dev caches
cleaner.description: Regenerable developer caches (Python, Node, editors, Chrome, Docker build).

option.label: Python package caches
option.description: pip, Poetry and Pipenv download caches

option.label: uv cache prune
option.description: Remove unused entries from the uv cache (runs: uv cache prune)

option.label: Node.js package caches
option.description: npm content cache, Yarn cache and node-gyp headers

option.label: pre-commit garbage collection
option.description: Remove hook environments no longer referenced (runs: pre-commit gc)

option.label: Cursor extra caches
option.description: Cursor updater cache, YAML schema cache and state database backup

option.label: Chrome component caches
option.description: Downloaded component, extension package and model-store caches

option.label: Docker dangling images and build cache
option.description: Runs docker image prune --force and docker builder prune --force (never containers or volumes)

option.label: Maven local repository
option.description: Every dependency is downloaded again on the next build
option.warning: Deletes ~/.m2/repository: next Maven builds re-download all dependencies.

option.label: Variety downloaded wallpapers
option.description: Wallpapers downloaded by Variety (favourites are kept elsewhere)
option.warning: Deletes downloaded wallpapers; Variety downloads new ones.
